mem.10:
John and Tim first chatted on 21 May 2023. Tim is a Harry Potter fan and works on fantasy-related projects; John is a professional basketball player.

14–20 May 2023: Tim and a Harry Potter fan friend brainstormed ideas for Tim’s Harry Potter project.

21 May 2023: Tim was developing a project about Harry Potter characters, spells and creatures. He loves the series as an escape and enjoyed a London tour that felt like walking into a movie; he offered John tips about related places. John had signed with the Minnesota Wolves as a shooting guard, was preparing for the season opener, and working on his shooting and adapting to the team. He liked discussing his sneaker collection. Photos included jerseys, a basketball machine, lockers, shoes, books and toys, a game, and Tim’s book-covered table.

15 June 2023: Tim had joined a fantasy-literature forum. John was exploring endorsements (Nike, Under Armour, or brands suited to his values) and shared a game photo, saying he loved being on court and gave his all. Tim shared books and a MinaLima picture, admiring the Harry Potter film-prop designers.

Week of 9–15 July 2023: John scored 40 points in a tough win—his highest score ever at that time. His teammates celebrated together at a restaurant; he described them as a passionate second family.

16 July 2023: John had signed a Nike basketball shoe/gear deal and was discussing a possible Gatorade sponsorship; he also liked Under Armour. He looked forward to an August game in Seattle, which he loves for its energy, diversity, food, local seafood (especially crab), ocean and supportive fans. He recalled starting surfing around 2018 with friends and loving the freedom and nature. Tim finds escape in fantasy books. Photos included game scenes, jerseys, a letter, card, Seattle sunset, crab, beach/surfing, and Tim’s books and living room.

2 August 2023: Tim was writing fantasy-novel articles for an online magazine after pitching ideas through the forum; he covers characters, themes and book recommendations, especially enjoying Harry Potter and Game of Thrones. John recalled an intense Harry Potter trivia contest with Anthony at a charity event. He was reading an inspiring book about pursuing dreams.

9 August 2023: Tim had Skyped with his Harry Potter fan friend in California and they discussed possible collaboration. John had narrowly won an intense game, scoring the final basket. His close-knit teammates encourage him on and off court and feel like family. Tim recommended Patrick Rothfuss’s The Name of the Wind; John planned to read it.

11 August 2023: John had recently visited Chicago and liked its energy, friendly people and cultural variety. They discussed the camaraderie of live sports and fan events. Tim had written more articles and recommended The Name of the Wind, about a magician/musician protagonist; John added it to his list. John’s lucky basketball shoes symbolize resilience and his journey. His father signed him up for a local league at age 10; he continued through school, earned a college scholarship and was drafted, fulfilling his childhood dream. His goals are winning a championship and making a difference off court through charity. He was working with a local organization supporting disadvantaged children through sports and school.

17 August 2023: John reunited with teammates on 15 August after a trip; their welcome made him feel he belonged. Tim hoped to attend a September book conference. John shared a basketball signed by teammates, which comforts and motivates him and represents their support and friendship.

21 August 2023: John had found a new gym with a basketball court and cones, and adapted his routine there through trial and error. His notebook workout plan balances basketball, strength training and rest. He said strength training builds muscle, power, explosiveness and injury prevention, and improved his shooting accuracy, agility, speed and confidence. Tim had been studying, reading fantasy and learning piano. His favorite piece was a theme from Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone, reminding him of watching the movie with family, cozy with snacks and blankets. John also loved the first film and owned the whole collection. They shared family photos and discussed Thanksgiving traditions: Tim’s family prepares a feast, says what they’re thankful for, then watches movies including Home Alone, Elf and The Santa Clause. John shared his previous year’s Christmas tree; Tim shared a Harry Potter-themed tree he decorated himself and enjoyed making.

26 August 2023: Tim was overwhelmed by assignments and exams but was trying to balance studying with fantasy reading and not give up; he shared a photo of books. John said he was doing OK and had visited home the previous week, catching up with family and old friends and reminiscing about childhood. He shared a photo of a group of girls basketball players; he said they were his high-school teammates and had played together for four years. Tim had never been on a sports team and preferred reading fantasy and traveling to experience different kinds of magic. He shared a bookshelf photo. John shared a New York City skyscraper/cityscape photo and said he loved exploring the city and trying its restaurants; he praised NYC’s culture and food as a must-visit. Tim added NYC to his travel list and said he couldn’t wait to visit. John offered to help plan when Tim knew his travel dates; Tim promised to let him know and thanked him for his support.

31 August 2023: Tim said he had been turned down for a summer job he wanted but was staying positive. John encouraged him. John said his NYC trip had gone okay; he initially struggled to figure out the subway but someone explained it, after which it was easy. Tim had given a class presentation the day before; he was nervous but did it and felt it was a small step forward. John praised him and shared a photo of homemade soup with a spoon and a butternut squash on a cutting board. He had improvised the recipe and couldn’t provide one, but said he used sage. Tim likes experimenting with spices and planned to look up recipes. Tim was planning his first-ever Universal Studios trip the following month, especially excited for the Harry Potter attractions. John hadn’t been but had heard good things and hoped to visit someday. Tim promised to report back; they wished each other a safe trip and said they’d catch up soon.
